Based on python-asyncdgt by Niklas Fiekas.
Upstream: https://github.com/niklasf/python-asyncdgt
Upstream license: GNU GPL version 3 or later; see LICENSE.txt.

Local changes: legacy generator-based asyncio coroutines were converted to
async/await, obsolete asyncio loop parameters were removed, and the pySerial
write_timeout attribute is used for modern pySerial versions.
